name: Ex-gratia for Death for the Construction Workers
briefDescription: This welfare scheme by the Labour Department, DNH & DD, provides financial assistance to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers who have passed away.
descriptionMd:
The Ex-gratia for Death for the Construction Workers scheme, initiated by the BOCW Welfare Board under the Labour Department of DNH & DD, aims to provide crucial financial support.
It offers ex-gratia payments to the nominees or dependents of registered construction workers who have unfortunately passed away.
This ensures that the families of these workers receive assistance during a difficult time.
benefitsMd: - Financial assistance for death is provided to the nominees/dependents of a deceased registered member.
eligibilityMd:
- The deceased must have been a construction worker.
- The deceased worker must have been a registered member of the scheme.
- The claim must be made by a nominee or dependent of the deceased registered member.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
